game.title: Pokémon Brilliant Diamond
game.notes: Genesis Mode. Nintendo Switch has no native achievement/trophy system, and Brilliant Diamond has never released on any other platform. No paid DLC or expansion pass exists for this game — no `dlc` block. Scope decisions made at the research checkpoint: (1) Manaphy, Shaymin, and Darkrai were all real-world time-limited Mystery Gift distributions (Nov 2021-Apr 2022) with no confirmed re-run since, and are excluded from this list entirely as permanently expired — unlike the other three Mythicals. (2) Mew (PBD-023), Jirachi (PBD-024), and Arceus (PBD-029) are each gated behind linked save data from another specific game (Let's Go Pikachu/Eevee, Sword/Shield, and a completed Legends: Arceus save respectively) but have NO time limit — included at explicit user request, who confirmed owning all three prerequisites; each is marked missable with a notes field disclosing the dependency. Mew and Jirachi share the same tier (Silver) since both are functionally identical NPC handouts gated purely on detecting linked save data, with no completion requirement for either linked title; Arceus alone sits at Gold because it requires a fully completed Legends: Arceus save, a materially bigger ask. (3) PBD-027 (National Dex completion) verifies via the Shiny Charm reward; note that in this specific game the Shiny Charm only boosts breeding shiny odds, not wild-encounter or Poké Radar odds (a documented quirk), so no trophy claims otherwise. (4) The classic Gen IV Underground flag-capture minigame was confirmed REMOVED in this remake — no trophy references it. (5) No trophy requires Global Wonder Station (Wonder Trade) or any online/multiplayer feature, per Rule 13 — these were also confirmed added post-launch (v1.3.0), not present at initial release. (6) Trophy Garden's rotating roster is confirmed NOT version-exclusive (identical content between Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl, save-file/time-based) and is not used as a version-exclusive trophy hook; Ramanas Park's Johto/Rainbow Room (Raikou/Entei/Suicune/Ho-Oh) is the genuine, confirmed Brilliant-Diamond-exclusive collection hook used instead (PBD-028). (7) PBD-017 (first Ramanas Park catch) is tiered Silver rather than Bronze and positioned after the pre-Hall-of-Fame Silver trophies (badges, commanders, lake trio), since Ramanas Park only unlocks after National Dex + Hall of Fame — placing it earlier would misrepresent the list as a chronological retrospective (Rule 19).

trophies.name: Off on an Adventure
trophies.description: Begin your journey in Sinnoh and receive your starter Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The opening story sequence concludes with the starter Pokémon added to the party.

trophies.name: First Badge
trophies.description: Defeat your first Gym Leader and earn a Badge.
trophies.verification: The Gym Leader's defeat cutscene plays and the Badge is added to the Badge Case.

trophies.name: Galactic Takedown
trophies.description: Defeat Cyrus at the Team Galactic HQ in Veilstone City.
trophies.verification: Cyrus's defeat triggers the HQ infiltration's clear cutscene and the Master Ball is added to the Bag.

trophies.name: A Glimmer in Sinnoh
trophies.description: Catch a Shiny Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Shiny Pokémon is added to the party or box with its distinct color and sparkle animation.

trophies.name: A Place of Your Own
trophies.description: Build your Secret Base in the Grand Underground for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Secret Base is created and can be entered from the Grand Underground.

trophies.name: Second Chance
trophies.description: Use the Move Reminder to relearn a move with a Heart Scale.
trophies.verification: The relearned move appears in the Pokémon's move set.

trophies.name: A Walk in the Square
trophies.description: Take a Pokémon for a walk at Amity Square.
trophies.verification: The chosen Pokémon follows the player around Amity Square outside its Poké Ball.

trophies.name: Something Good
trophies.description: Collect 40 Diglett and Dugtrio sparkle points in the Grand Underground.
trophies.verification: The on-screen Diglett-icon counter reaches 40, triggering the shared shiny-odds and Gorgeous Box bonus.

trophies.name: Ribbon Debut
trophies.description: Win a Ribbon in a Super Contest Show for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Ribbon appears on the winning Pokémon's summary screen.

trophies.name: Streak Starter
trophies.description: Win a 7-battle streak at the Battle Park.
trophies.verification: The 7th consecutive win clears the streak and awards Battle Points.

trophies.name: Beyond Sinnoh
trophies.description: Unlock the National Pokédex.
trophies.verification: The Pokédex menu switches to National mode after speaking with Professor Rowan.

trophies.name: Voice of the Lake
trophies.description: Catch Uxie, Mesprit, or Azelf for the first time.
trophies.verification: The caught lake guardian is registered in the Pokédex.

trophies.name: Hidden Away
trophies.description: Discover a Pokémon Hideaway in the Grand Underground for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Hideaway room loads and its wild Pokémon become visible.

trophies.name: Full Badge Case
trophies.description: Earn all 8 Gym Badges.
trophies.verification: The Badge Case screen shows all 8 Badges present.

trophies.name: Commanders Fall
trophies.description: Defeat each of Team Galactic's commanders — Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn — at least once.
trophies.verification: Each commander's defeat triggers their respective battle's clear dialogue.

trophies.name: Trio of the Lake
trophies.description: Catch all three lake guardians: Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf.
trophies.verification: All three are registered as caught in the Pokédex.

trophies.name: Park Ranger
trophies.description: Catch your first Legendary Pokémon at Ramanas Park.
trophies.verification: The caught Pokémon is added to the party or box, and a matching statue appears in the room.

trophies.name: Heart of the Volcano
trophies.description: Catch Heatran at Stark Mountain.
trophies.verification: Heatran is added to the party or box.

trophies.name: Through the Reversed World
trophies.description: Catch Giratina at Turnback Cave.
trophies.verification: Giratina is added to the party or box.

trophies.name: Star of Every Show
trophies.description: Earn the Contest Star Ribbon by winning all five Super Contest Show categories at Master Rank.
trophies.verification: The Contest Star Ribbon appears on the winning Pokémon's summary screen.

trophies.name: Shadow of the Distortion
trophies.description: Defeat Giratina in Ramanas Park's Distortion Room and obtain the Griseous Orb.
trophies.verification: Giratina's defeat flips the room and adds the Griseous Orb to the Bag.

trophies.name: League Rematch
trophies.description: Defeat the Elite Four and Champion Cynthia in a rematch.
trophies.verification: Cynthia's rematch defeat triggers its own clear dialogue, distinct from the first title match.

trophies.name: Wish Maker
trophies.description: Catch Mew, using linked Pokémon Let's Go, Pikachu! or Let's Go, Eevee! save data on the same Switch.
trophies.verification: Mew is added to the party or box.
trophies.notes: Requires a Nintendo Switch with linked Pokémon Let's Go, Pikachu! or Let's Go, Eevee! save data present — an external ownership dependency (not a time-limited window) beyond owning this game alone. Included at explicit user request.

trophies.name: Wishing Star
trophies.description: Catch Jirachi, using linked Pokémon Sword or Shield save data on the same Switch.
trophies.verification: Jirachi is added to the party or box.
trophies.notes: Requires a Nintendo Switch with linked Pokémon Sword or Shield save data present — an external ownership dependency (not a time-limited window) beyond owning this game alone. Included at explicit user request.

trophies.name: Master of Time
trophies.description: Defeat Cyrus at Spear Pillar and catch Dialga, resolving the Team Galactic crisis.
trophies.verification: Dialga is registered in the Pokédex following the Spear Pillar climax.

trophies.name: Sinnoh League Champion
trophies.description: Defeat Champion Cynthia and enter the Hall of Fame.
trophies.verification: Cynthia's defeat triggers the Hall of Fame registration sequence.

trophies.name: Sinnoh's Pokémon Professor
trophies.description: Complete the National Pokédex.
trophies.verification: The Shiny Charm is granted by the game director at Valor Lakefront, confirming every non-Mythical National Dex species has been caught.

trophies.name: Beasts and the Rainbow
trophies.description: Catch every Legendary Pokémon exclusive to Brilliant Diamond at Ramanas Park: Raikou, Entei, Suicune, and Ho-Oh.
trophies.verification: All four are registered as caught in the Pokédex, with matching statues in the Johto and Rainbow Rooms.

trophies.name: The Original One Returns
trophies.description: Catch Arceus at Spear Pillar, using a completed Pokémon Legends: Arceus save file.
trophies.verification: Arceus is added to the party or box following the Azure Flute/Hall of Origin event.
trophies.notes: Requires a Nintendo Switch with a completed Pokémon Legends: Arceus save file present — an external ownership and progress dependency (not a time-limited window) beyond owning this game alone. Included at explicit user request.

trophies.name: Twinkling Star
trophies.description: Earn the Twinkling Star Ribbon by winning the Brilliant Contest at Master Rank.
trophies.verification: The Twinkling Star Ribbon appears on the winning Pokémon's summary screen.

trophies.name: Diamond of Sinnoh
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies earned.
